latest_comment.raw_content:
Dear fellow investors,

On Wednesday the 𝟰𝘁𝗵 𝗼𝗳 𝗡𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 2026,
I will deliver my 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗹𝘆 𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲 for the 4th quarter of 2026.

The presentation will cover my background, investment principles, and 𝗶𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝘆, along with an update on the state of the global economy, 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸 for different markets, and a review of my current portfolio.

If you have 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗾𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 or topics, you would like me to address at the end of the presentation, 𝗽𝗹𝗲𝗮𝘀𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝗮 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 on this post.

You can also write to me directly on LinkedIn or X:
www.linkedin.com/in/jeppekirkbonde
www.x.com/jeppekirkbonde

The video from the presentation will be posted here on eToro on the same day.

I look forward to reading and answering all of your questions.

Best regards,
Jeppe Kirk Bonde
